column1: # Methodology rules a project's role templates must carry, checked by kanban-sync.py.
# roles: comma-separated template names (common = the implement card).
# want:  present — the project's copy must contain the marker;
#        absent  — it must not (a rule that would break the role).
# marker: a literal substring of the rule's bullet in templates/roles/<role>.md, specific enough that a project
#         which paraphrased the rest of the bullet still matches. The package's own templates must satisfy every
#         line (tests/run.sh checks it), so a marker cannot drift away from the text it stands for.
